shortDescription: Taiwan’s government has launched an international organization for the first time to help tackle disasters, according to Bloomberg.The move comes as Taiwan seeks to counter China’s growing campaign to isolate it on the global stage.

title: Taiwan Launches First International Disaster-Response Body Amid China Pressure
